title: Goals close on the live loop: goal.close accepts the verifier receipt and the landing receipt as the verification leg
description:

PRODUCT GAP, measured at main 68eb1c5d and on the live UnAI store: every goal stays EXECUTION_ENABLED forever. Three UnAI goals have accepted nodes (node-uai-core-identities and node-uai-evidence-ledger accepted 2026-09-02 with `ReviewOutputAccepted` + `VerifierReceiptRecorded`; evidence-ledger-durable-ingest accepted 2026-09-04 08:20Z) and none can close: `goal.close` (payload `["closureWitness", "goalId", "zeroAuthorityWitness"]`, daemon-command-vocabulary.ts) is served through `apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-close-prerequisite.ts` and `apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-qualification.ts:139-164` (`zeroAuthority`), whose verification leg compares FOUNDATION receipt fields (`receipt.*`) that only the seeded Foundation journey produces. A real seat's node carries `moe-verifier-receipt` + `integration.accept_output` + `moe-landing-receipt/1`, never a Foundation RECEIPTED row, so `NodeClosure.receipt` is absent and closure refuses. The control room's status strip already computes READY_TO_CLOSE ("All N acceptance criteria are verified", goal-status.ts:130-142) and Needs you offers the close when the daemon does - the daemon never does for a real goal.

FEATURE: closure over the live loop's own evidence. For each node in the goal's activated graph, the verification leg accepts EITHER the Foundation receipt (seed journey, unchanged) OR the pair {verifier receipt with proof PASSED (apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/verifier-receipt-ledger.ts), acceptance `ReviewOutputAccepted`} plus, when landing is on, a `moe-landing-receipt/1` (COMMITTED, or REFUSED with NOTHING_TO_COMMIT which is a legitimate outcome when the workspace already held the work). `NodeClosure.receipt` becomes optional; `compose`, `zeroAuthority` and `verifiedResultHolds` skip the Foundation leg when no RECEIPTED row names the node and take the live leg instead; the closure witness names which leg proved each node. The daemon OFFERS `goal.close` on `/affordances/read` once every node of the goal is accepted and every approved criterion reads VERIFIED on the coverage read (document-coverage-read.ts). UI: Needs you's existing close card (needs-you-model.ts CLOSE kind) works unchanged; the board header's stage moves READY_TO_CLOSE -> CLOSED (STAGE_WORDS "Closed") and the goals list card reads Done.

Out of scope: expansion runs; multi-node ordering (sibling row task-4423d2a4); the Foundation seed path stays byte-for-byte.
